# ABC News

> > Breaking news and in-depth reporting on U.S. politics, international conflicts, and cultural stories from ABC News.

ABC News is a major American broadcast news network providing comprehensive coverage of global events, with particular focus on Middle East conflicts, U.S. political developments, and human interest stories. The site features live updates, investigative reporting, and multimedia content across news categories.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- International News
- Middle East Conflict
- Iran-Israel Tensions
- U.S. Politics
- Trump
- Live Updates
- Military News
- Lebanon
- Iraq
- Tehran
- Top Stories
- World News
- Global Events

## Core News & Breaking Updates

- [ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos](https://abcnews.com/): ABC News homepage with breaking news on Trump, Iran, and Middle East
- [As Iran retaliates, largest US military base in Middle East hit by ballistic missile, Qatar says - ABC News](https://abcnews.com/International/live-updates/iran-live-updates-israel-launches-preemptive-strike-iran/?id=130301492): Live updates on US-Israel strike on Iran and Al Udeid Air Base attack

## International & World News

- [International News | Latest World News, Videos & Photos - ABC News](https://abcnews.com/International): World news section covering Asia, Europe, Middle East conflicts and events
